description.narrative:
Alliance Frugal Innovation Centre (AFIC) will scale its social enterprise model in Arba Minch, Ethiopia, to address youth unemployment and the lack of affordable startup support. Building on our pilot success, this project focuses on the responsible growth of ourrevenue-generating Alliance Innovation Park and EdTech department. The grant will enable us to upgrade our Frugal Innovation Lab with advanced prototyping tools and expand our rental workspaces. This infrastructure growth directly subsidizes our core mission: providing incubation for marginalized youth, women, and street-connected children. By enhancing our internal revenue streams like office rentals, short-term skills training, and digital education services, AFIC will ensure long-term sustainability while incubating 60+ new entrepreneurs annually. This project transforms local waste into wealth and unemployed youth into job creators, bridging the gap between skills and market access.
Goal: To scale AFIC’s social enterprise revenue streams to sustainably fund youth incubation and job creation.
Objectives: 1. Expand the Alliance Innovation Park capacity for rental income and incubation space. 2. Professionalize the EdTech department to increase sales of digital solutions to schools. 3. Incubate two cohorts (approx. 60 youth) with a focus on women and marginalized groups like street children.
Activities: Upgrading the Frugal Innovation Lab with equipment. Delivering3-month incubation (training, mentorship, prototyping). Hosting GITA Fest and rooftop pitch events for market linkages.

participating-org.narrative: 1 Vision: AFIC envisions a Southern Ethiopian ecosystem where student, youth, women and low–income community members transform locally available resources into sustainable enterprises that create jobs, recycle materials and solve social problems. 2 Mission: AFIC’s mission is to empower communities from resource–limited backgrounds to innovate and build entrepreneurial solutions for self–employment using frugal innovation principles. 3 Strategic Goals 1. Provide high–quality incubation services that convert promising ideasinto market–ready products and services. 2. Promote frugal innovation as a practical, inclusive approach to entrepreneurship and problem solving. 3. Strengthen the local ecosystem through partnerships with universities, TVETs, government offices and internationalresearch centres. 4. Serve as a CEED–type hub that links training, research, incubation and community outreach in Arba Minch. 4 Operational Objectives • Incubate at least two cohorts per year under its business six month business incubation program with a strong focus on youth and women. • Provide short term skills trainings that directly support employability and self–employment. • Facilitate access to seed finance, angel investment and revolving funds for promising ventures. • Use frugal innovation methods to reduce startup costs, recycle materials and lower barriers to entry.
